body_html:
Engineered for comfort that holds up all day, the Basics Comfort-Time Ultra Multi-Tilter is a big & tall ergonomic office chair designed specifically for users of above-average height and weight. A height-adjustable headrest, generously scaled seat and waterfall edge keep you supported through back-to-back meetings, long shifts and everything in between. With independent seat and back angle control plus a full suite of adjustments, it adapts to the person rather than the other way around.

Features

  • Big & tall design intended for users of above-average height and weight
  • Adjustable headrest for added upper-back and neck support
  • Pneumatic seat-height adjustment and seat-depth adjustment
  • Independent, infinitely adjustable seat and back angle
  • Adjustable back angle and back-height adjustment
  • Tilt lock and tilt-tension control
  • Articulating arm caps and a waterfall seat edge
  • Durable Fusion fabric upholstery on a five-star base with hard-floor casters

Specifications

This is a high-back task chair upholstered in durable Fusion fabric over moulded foam, shipped in Carbon with additional fabric colours available on request. Made in Canada by Global Furniture Group and backed by a 2-year warranty on upholstery, foam and moving mechanisms (rated for an eight-hour single shift, users up to 275 lbs).

Brant Business Interiors is a family-owned Canadian dealer (in business since 1964, based at 296 George St N, Peterborough ON) and an OECM-eligible supplier, so Ontario institutional buyers can purchase without an open tender. For volume pricing, full dimensions or fabric options, Request a Quote or call 1-800-835-9565.
